# Storage methods that only tests call.
#
# Each line is one exported method on storage.Store or storage.CaptureStage that
# has zero production callers and at least one test caller. Seeding or asserting
# through such a method proves a state a real tx install cannot reach: that is
# precisely how the session bug survived a green suite for 174 published
# bundles, seeded by store.WriteSession, which no production code ever called.
#
# THIS LIST IS A RATCHET. Entries may be removed, never added.
# TestSeedersAreProductionWriters fails both ways: on an unlisted offender, and
# on a listed name that is no longer one. Removing an entry means either wiring
# the method into production, rewriting the test to seed through the writer
# production uses, or deleting the method.
#
# Already removed:
#   WriteSession — deleted outright. Its fourteen test call sites now use
#   UpsertObservedSession (the push path's writer, called by
#   vcs.AttachSessionsFromHunkLinks) or UpsertCursorSession (the ingest path,
#   the only production writer of process_name and last_seen_at).

# --- Session rows nothing in production writes any more --------------------
# The daemon that wrote these is deleted. Rewriting the tests means deciding
# whether sessions still need client_pid/exit_code/end_reason at all.
UpsertSession           no production caller; UpsertObservedSession replaced it on the push path
UpsertSessionContext    no production caller; session_contexts is empty on real machines
SessionContext          read side of the above

# --- Proxy-era request/response rows ---------------------------------------
# `requests` and `responses` are both empty on a real machine, yet the bundle's
# session payload assertions are built on them. Nothing writes them since the
# proxy was removed.
WriteRequest            no production caller; requests table is empty on real installs
WriteResponse           no production caller; responses table is empty on real installs

# --- Demux proposals -------------------------------------------------------
# reviewbundle reads change_demux_evidence to build revision.ReviewContext, but
# nothing in production ever writes it, so that whole branch is validated only
# against data a real machine cannot produce. Removing these entries forces the
# decision: wire demux back up, or stop reading a table nothing fills.
UpsertDemuxProposal                 no production writer of demux_proposals
FindDemuxProposal                   read side of the above
FindLatestDemuxProposal             read side of the above
ListDemuxProposals                  read side of the above
UpdateDemuxProposalStatus           read/write side of the above
DeletePendingDemuxProposalsForRepo  read/write side of the above
WriteChangeDemuxEvidence            no production writer of change_demux_evidence
ListChangeDemuxEvidenceByProposal   read side of the above

# --- Capture staging queries that differ from the ones production runs ------
# PendingSessions is `WHERE uploaded_at IS NULL`; production uploads through
# ShareableSessions, which also requires `shareable_at IS NOT NULL` and bounded
# attempts. On the author's database the two differ by 121 rows / 9.7 MB, every
# one of them invisible to production and visible to every test asserting
# through PendingSessions. Same divergence for extracts.
PendingSessions         production uploads through ShareableSessions, not this
PendingExtracts         production uploads through ShareableExtracts, not this
